## What was wrong
`Form` gives its non-field errors a `nonfield` CSS class (`self.error_class(error_class='nonfield')`, django/forms/forms.py:317), but `BaseFormSet` built its non-form error lists in `full_clean()` with no `error_class` argument at all — so a custom `ErrorList` had no way to distinguish non-form (formset-level) errors when rendering.
